evidence_items.publisher: Frank F. Xu and colleagues, arXiv
evidence_items.locator: Section 1, discussion immediately after the experimental results
evidence_items.explanation: The researchers demonstrate autonomous task completion, which challenges a broad definition of agent nonexistence. They also distinguish these successes from automating an entire workplace; the results precede the target month and do not establish unsupervised worker replacement.

evidence_items.locator: Section RAG to riches?, paragraph describing human support
evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic reports that its shop-running systems still required people to resolve customer difficulties as well as perform physical work. This limits the demonstration as a counterexample to oversight-free worker replacement, but does not prove that such systems are impossible.

unresolved_gaps: No operational threshold separates the speaker's autonomous worker from an imperfect task-performing agent.
The examined evidence does not establish complete oversight-free job performance in the target period.
